glosses: entrance (doorway or passageway into a building or other enclosed space)
entrance (place for entering a defined area that is not necessarily enclosed, e.g. a forest)
input (interface of a device for receiving data, e.g. through a socket)

examples.text: Beide Eingänge zum Zimmer sind bewacht.
examples.en: Both of the entrances to the room are guarded.

examples.text: Ich warte am Eingang auf dich.
examples.en: I'll wait for you at the entrance.

examples.text: Siehst du den Eingang von dem Park?
examples.en: Do you see the entrance of the park?
